title: Capture Pane to File
description: save current pane scrollback to ~/tmux-captures

action.tmux: run-shell 'mkdir -p "$HOME/tmux-captures"; file="$HOME/tmux-captures/tmux-capture-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).txt"; tmux capture-pane -pS - -t "#{pane_id}" > "$file"; tmux display-message "Captured pane to $file"'

title: Repository Overview
description: show Onefetch statistics for the current repository

action.tmux: display-popup -E -d '#{pane_current_path}' -w '90%' -h '90%' "sh -lc 'onefetch; printf \"\nPress Enter to close\"; read -r _'"
